A '''living gas cloud''' drifted in [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]].

==Biology==
The living [[gas cloud]] was a strange [[Species/Legends|lifeform]] living in the [[Realspace/Legends|interstellar void]]. It looked like a moving luminescent [[Gas/Legends|gas]] [[Cloud/Legends|cloud]], and it was able to protrude a feeler-like appendage.<ref name="RPG" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a member of this species drifted in the way of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and was able to draw it our of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. The creature tried to touch the ship with a feeler.<ref name="RPG" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species' first and only appearance is the [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|first edition rulebook]] of [[West End Games]]'s [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]], designed by [[Greg Costikyan]] and published in [[October]] [[1987]].
